resources.string: A sine sweep out, the remote microphone listening, a curve you can trust.
Hold the room still for 10 seconds
The TV plays a sine sweep. The remote microphone listens. Nothing leaves this device.
Press OK to start the stimulus
One frequency at a time, so it beats room noise. Loud enough to hear over the room, quiet enough to live with.
Point the remote at your seat
Where your ears are, not at the TV. The remote microphone is the only microphone this can use.
Keep the room quiet while the bar fills
Footsteps and fans land in the same capture. Dips that are cancellations get left alone.
